lines.text: 옛날에 아기를 기다리는 부부가 살았어요. 아기가 곧 올 거예요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, there lived a husband and wife who were waiting for a baby. The baby was coming soon.
segs: Once upon a time, there lived a husband and wife who were waiting for a baby. The baby was coming soon.

lines.text: 담 너머 텃밭은 마녀 고텔의 마법 텃밭이라 아무도 들어가지 못했어요.
lines.en: Beyond the wall was the magic garden of the witch Gothel, and no one was allowed in.
segs: Beyond the wall was the magic garden of the witch Gothel, and no one was allowed in.

lines.text: 저 라푼젤 풀이 너무너무 먹고 싶어요.
lines.en: Oh, I want to eat that rampion so, so much.
segs: Oh, I want to eat that rampion so, so much.

lines.text: 내가 가져올게요.
lines.en: I'll go and get some for you.
segs: I'll go and get some for you.

lines.text: 밤이 되자, 아버지는 살금살금 담을 넘었어요.
lines.en: When night came, the father quietly climbed over the wall.
segs: When night came, the father quietly climbed over the wall.

lines.text: 누구냐! 내 풀을 뽑다니!
lines.en: Who's there! Pulling up my rampion!
segs: Who's there! Pulling up my rampion!

lines.text: 아, 아내가 너무너무 먹고 싶어 해서요.
lines.en: Oh! My wife wanted it so, so much.
segs: Oh! My wife wanted it so, so much.

lines.text: 내 풀을 가져가도 좋다. 대신 아기가 태어나면 내가 키우마.
lines.en: You may take my rampion. But when the baby is born, I shall raise it.
segs: You may take my rampion. But when the baby is born, I shall raise it.

lines.text: 네… 알겠어요.
lines.en: Yes... all right.

lines.text: 아기가 태어났어요. 마녀 고텔은 아기를 데려가 라푼젤이라고 이름 짓고 정성껏 키웠어요.
lines.en: The baby was born. The witch Gothel took her away, named her Rapunzel, and raised her with care.
segs: The baby was born. The witch Gothel took her away, named her Rapunzel, and raised her with care.

lines.text: 라푼젤이 열두 살이 되자, 마녀는 지팡이를 톡 두드렸어요.
lines.en: When Rapunzel turned twelve, the witch tapped her stick on the ground.
segs: When Rapunzel turned twelve, the witch tapped her stick on the ground.

lines.text: 숲속에 문도 계단도 없는 높은 탑이 쑥 솟았어요. 창문은 꼭대기에 하나뿐이에요.
lines.en: Up rose a tall tower in the forest, with no door and no stairs. There was only one window, right at the top.
segs: Up rose a tall tower in the forest, with no door and no stairs. There was only one window, right at the top.

lines.text: 자, 잠겨라. 밖은 위험하단다. 여기가 제일 안전해.
lines.en: Now, lock tight. The outside is dangerous. This is the safest place.
segs: Now, lock tight. The outside is dangerous. This is the safest place.

lines.text: 지붕 위에는 새 한 마리, 탑 아래에는 토끼 한 마리가 있어요.
lines.en: On top of the roof sits a bird, and down below the tower sits a rabbit.
segs: On top of the roof sits a bird, and down below the tower sits a rabbit.

lines.text: 탑 위에 있는 새를 톡, 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Tap the bird on top of the tower.
segs: Tap the bird on top of the tower.

lines.text: 그건 탑 아래에 있는 토끼예요. 위를 봐요.
lines.en: That's the rabbit below the tower. Look up.
segs: That's the rabbit below the tower. Look up.

lines.text: 맞아요, 탑 위에 새!
lines.en: That's right, the bird on top!
segs: That's right, the bird on top!

lines.text: 이번엔 탑 아래에 있는 토끼를 톡, 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Now tap the rabbit below the tower.
segs: Now tap the rabbit below the tower.

lines.text: 그건 탑 위에 있는 새예요. 아래를 봐요.
lines.en: That's the bird on top of the tower. Look down.
segs: That's the bird on top of the tower. Look down.

lines.text: 맞아요, 탑 아래에 토끼!
lines.en: That's right, the rabbit below!

lines.text: 라푼젤, 라푼젤, 머리를 내려 줘!
lines.en: Rapunzel, Rapunzel, let down your hair!
segs: Rapunzel, Rapunzel, let down your hair!

lines.text: 스르르~ 금빛 머리가 탑 아래까지 닿았어요.
lines.en: Swish... the golden hair slid all the way down to the foot of the tower.
segs: Swish... the golden hair slid all the way down to the foot of the tower.

lines.text: 고텔은 머리를 잡고 천천히 올라가요.
lines.en: Gothel took hold of the hair and slowly climbed up.
segs: Gothel took hold of the hair and slowly climbed up.

lines.text: 라푼젤은 혼자 있을 때면 창가에서 노래를 불렀어요.
lines.en: Whenever Rapunzel was alone, she sang at the window.
segs: Whenever Rapunzel was alone, she sang at the window.

lines.text: 내 노래가 숲 끝까지 닿았으면.
lines.en: I wish my song could reach the end of the forest.
segs: I wish my song could reach the end of the forest.

lines.text: 바닥에 리본 세 개가 있어요. 길이가 다 달라요.
lines.en: There are three ribbons on the floor. They are all different lengths.
segs: There are three ribbons on the floor. They are all different lengths.

lines.text: 라푼젤 머리를 묶을 제일 긴 리본을 찾아봐요.
lines.en: Find the longest ribbon to tie Rapunzel's hair.
segs: Find the longest ribbon to tie Rapunzel's hair.

lines.text: 그건 중간 리본이에요. 더 긴 리본이 있어요.
lines.en: That's the middle ribbon. There's a longer one.
segs: That's the middle ribbon. There's a longer one.

lines.text: 그건 제일 짧은 리본이에요. 더 긴 리본이 있어요.
lines.en: That's the shortest ribbon. There's a longer one.
segs: That's the shortest ribbon. There's a longer one.

lines.text: 맞아요, 제일 긴 리본!
lines.en: That's right, the longest ribbon!

lines.text: 그럼 제일 짧은 리본은 어디 있을까요?
lines.en: Now, where is the shortest ribbon?
segs: Now, where is the shortest ribbon?

lines.text: 그건 중간 리본이에요. 더 짧은 리본이 있어요.
lines.en: That's the middle ribbon. There's a shorter one.
segs: That's the middle ribbon. There's a shorter one.

lines.text: 맞아요, 제일 짧은 리본!
lines.en: That's right, the shortest ribbon!

lines.text: 라푼젤은 리본을 묶은 머리를 창가에 늘어뜨리고 또 노래했어요.
lines.en: Rapunzel let her ribboned hair hang at the window and sang again.
segs: Rapunzel let her ribboned hair hang at the window and sang again.

lines.text: 어느 해질녘, 숲을 지나던 왕자가 노랫소리를 들었어요.
lines.en: One evening at sunset, a prince riding through the forest heard the singing.
segs: One evening at sunset, a prince riding through the forest heard the singing.

lines.text: 어디서 이렇게 고운 노래가 들리지?
lines.en: Where is that lovely song coming from?
segs: Where is that lovely song coming from?

lines.text: 왕자는 탑을 한 바퀴 돌았지만 문이 없었어요.
lines.en: The prince walked all the way around the tower, but there was no door.
segs: The prince walked all the way around the tower, but there was no door.

lines.text: 그때 마녀 고텔이 왔어요. 왕자는 나무 뒤에 숨었어요.
lines.en: Just then the witch Gothel came. The prince hid behind a tree.
segs: Just then the witch Gothel came. The prince hid behind a tree.

lines.text: 아, 저렇게 올라가는구나!
lines.en: Ah, so that's how you get up there!
segs: Ah, so that's how you get up there!

lines.text: 다음 날 저녁, 왕자는 탑 아래에서 외쳤어요.
lines.en: The next evening, the prince called out from the foot of the tower.
segs: The next evening, the prince called out from the foot of the tower.

lines.text: 라푼젤, 라푼젤, 머리를 내려 줘요!
lines.en: Rapunzel, Rapunzel, let down your hair!
segs: Rapunzel, Rapunzel, let down your hair!

lines.text: 어머, 할머니가 아니네?
lines.en: Oh my, you're not Grandmother?

lines.text: 놀라게 해서 미안해요. 노래가 너무 고와서 왔어요. 저와 함께 성으로 가요.
lines.en: I'm sorry I startled you. Your song was so lovely that I came. Come with me to my castle.
segs: I'm sorry I startled you. Your song was so lovely that I came. Come with me to my castle.

lines.text: 좋아요. 비단실을 가져오면 사다리를 엮을게요.
lines.en: All right. If you bring me silk thread, I'll weave a ladder.
segs: All right. If you bring me silk thread, I'll weave a ladder.

lines.text: 그날부터 왕자는 저녁마다 비단실을 가져왔어요.
lines.en: From that day on, the prince brought silk thread every evening.
segs: From that day on, the prince brought silk thread every evening.

lines.text: 어느 날, 라푼젤이 무심코 말했어요.
lines.en: One day, Rapunzel said without thinking,
segs: One day, Rapunzel said without thinking,

lines.text: 할머니, 할머니는 왜 왕자님보다 훨씬 무거워요?
lines.en: Grandmother, why are you so much heavier than the prince?
segs: Grandmother, why are you so much heavier than the prince?

lines.text: 뭐라고? 왕자라니!
lines.en: What? A prince!

lines.text: 마녀는 가위 한 번으로 라푼젤의 머리를 자르고, 지팡이를 톡 두드려 먼 들판의 작은 오두막으로 데려갔어요.
lines.en: With one snip of her scissors the witch cut off Rapunzel's hair, then tapped her stick and took her away to a little cottage in a faraway meadow.
segs: With one snip of her scissors the witch cut off Rapunzel's hair, then tapped her stick and took her away to a little cottage in a faraway meadow.

lines.text: 그날 저녁, 왕자는 아무것도 모르고 탑에 왔어요.
lines.en: That evening, the prince came to the tower, knowing nothing.
segs: That evening, the prince came to the tower, knowing nothing.

lines.text: 마녀는 잘린 머리를 고리에 걸어 내려 주었어요.
lines.en: The witch hung the cut-off braid on the hook and let it down.
segs: The witch hung the cut-off braid on the hook and let it down.

lines.text: 라푼젤은 여기 없다. 다시는 못 볼 거다. 자, 내려가라.
lines.en: Rapunzel is not here. You will never see her again. Now, down you go.
segs: Rapunzel is not here. You will never see her again. Now, down you go.

lines.text: 휘익~ 마법 바람이 왕자를 탑 아래 풀숲에 사뿐 내려놓았어요.
lines.en: Whoosh... a magic wind set the prince gently down in the grass below the tower.
segs: Whoosh... a magic wind set the prince gently down in the grass below the tower.

lines.text: 라푼젤… 어디로 갔을까.
lines.en: Rapunzel... where could she be?

lines.text: 왕자는 슬픈 얼굴로 숲을 걷고 또 걸었어요.
lines.en: The prince walked and walked through the forest with a sad face.
segs: The prince walked and walked through the forest with a sad face.

lines.text: 그때, 바람을 타고 노랫소리가 들려왔어요.
lines.en: Then, carried on the wind, came the sound of singing.
segs: Then, carried on the wind, came the sound of singing.

lines.text: 이 노래는… 라푼젤!
lines.en: That song... Rapunzel!

lines.text: 왕자님! 찾아와 줬군요.
lines.en: Prince! You came and found me.
segs: Prince! You came and found me.

lines.text: 포기하지 않길 잘했어요. 이제 함께 가요.
lines.en: I'm glad I never gave up. Let's go together now.
segs: I'm glad I never gave up. Let's go together now.

lines.text: 두 사람은 손을 꼭 잡고 성으로 떠났어요.
lines.en: The two held hands tightly and set off for the castle.
segs: The two held hands tightly and set off for the castle.

lines.text: 마녀 고텔은 텃밭으로 돌아갔어요.
lines.en: And the witch Gothel went back to her garden.
segs: And the witch Gothel went back to her garden.

hum: La la la, la la la~

ui.포기하지 않으면 다시 만날 수 있어요: Never give up, and you will meet again
